From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Supplier enrollment: intro call to align MAP, PO steps, and success criteria

Hi Sofia / Orchid team —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. To keep momentum and unblock procurement, we'd like to schedule a short intro call (25–30 min) to align on the mutual action plan (MAP), required vendor setup items, and PO timing. The goal is to leave the call with:

- A named procurement owner on your side and a Redwood owner
- MAP milestones (vendor docs, PO issuance, onboarding date) and target dates
- Confirmation of required artifacts (SOC2, data retention, KMS, vendor form)
- Next steps and owners for the vendor portal setup

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 2026-07-13 10:00–10:30
- Tue 2026-07-13 15:00–15:30
- Wed 2026-07-14 09:30–10:00

Attached is a draft procurement intake form and a short vendor onboarding guide to help your team prepare. Could you confirm who will be the procurement contact (name + email) and which of the above slots works best? If none work, propose two alternatives.

Proposed brief agenda (I can update based on your input):
1) Intros & role call (5 min)
2) MAP review: milestones & critical path (10 min)
3) PO flow, billing contacts, and vendor setup checklist (8 min)
4) Next steps & owners (2 min)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0174

Perfect — thanks Sofia and Rajesh. I've reserved Tue 7/13 15:00–15:30 PDT and will send a calendar invite. Quick logistics so we have the right people on the call:

Redwood attendees and quick notes:
- Marcus Lin (AE) — MAP owner, exec contact
- Laura Bennett (Contracts) — will review procurement/contract questions and PO redline needs
- Dev Patel (Finance Ops) — will confirm billing flow and PO ingestion details
- Grace Oconnor (Customer Success) — will own onboarding timeline once PO clears

Pre-call items (we'll bring these on the call):
- Redwood PO template (attached) and standard payment terms (Net30/Net45 options)
- Vendor portal link and vendor intake process doc (we support both self-serve portal and manual intake)
- Mutual Action Plan template (I've attached an MAP template so we can live-edit after the call)

Success criteria proposal (suggest we confirm on call):
1) Vendor record created in Orchid vendor system and Redwood added to your payment vendor list
2) PO received and accepted under agreed terms
3) SOC2 Type II report or equivalent provided to Orchid (access via secure link)
4) Onboarding start date scheduled with CS within 5 business days of PO acceptance

Attachments for the call: mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx (Excel), redwood_po_template.docx (Word)

I'll send the calendar invite in a separate message with the conference link. Looking forward to it.

Regards,
Marcus
